body:
### Question

My `pyproject.toml` says:
```
[tool.uv]
required-version = ">=0.13.5"
environments = [
    "sys_platform == 'darwin'",
    "sys_platform == 'linux' and (platform_machine == 'x86_64' or platform_machine == 'aarch64')",
]
```

I want to say something like `platform_libc == 'glibc'`, to exclude `musl` support. This is because some of the binary wheels I want to install don't exist for `musl` (and I don't think `uv` can build them from source, because they are actually `go` binaries being distributed via PyPI, not Python projects)

But does the feature I'm looking for actually exist? I don't think it does?

I tried to "abuse" the `minimum-libc-version` preview feature to do this (by setting an impossibly high musl version), but my attempts were unsuccessful, it just resulted in a resolution failure.

### Platform

macOS 15, Ubuntu 26.04

### Version

uv 0.13.5 (Homebrew 2026-10-22 aarch64-apple-darwin)
title: Is there a way to exclude musl support?
